int edge_cnt = 1, head[MAXN], to[MAXN], next_edge[MAXN], capacity[MAXN], cost[MAXN];
int dist[MAXN], bottleneck[MAXN], prev_edge[MAXN]; bool in_queue[MAXN];

void insert_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int w) {
	to[++edge_cnt] = v, next_edge[edge_cnt] = head[u], head[u] = edge_cnt, capacity[edge_cnt] = cap, cost[edge_cnt] = w;
	to[++edge_cnt] = u, next_edge[edge_cnt] = head[v], head[v] = edge_cnt, capacity[edge_cnt] = 0, cost[edge_cnt] = -w;
}
bool bellman_ford() {
	memset(bottleneck, 0, sizeof(bottleneck));
	memset(dist, INF, sizeof(dist));
	memset(in_queue, 0, sizeof(in_queue));
	queue<int> q;
	q.push(source);
	bottleneck[source] = INF;
	in_queue[source] = true;
	dist[source] = 0;
	while (!q.empty()) {
		int u = q.front(); q.pop();
		in_queue[u] = false;
		for (int e = head[u]; e; e = next_edge[e]) {
			if (capacity[e] == 0 || dist[to[e]] <= dist[u] + cost[e]) continue;
			dist[to[e]] = dist[u] + cost[e];
			bottleneck[to[e]] = min(bottleneck[u], capacity[e]);
			prev_edge[to[e]] = e;
			if (!in_queue[to[e]]) {
				in_queue[to[e]] = true;
				q.push(to[e]);
			}
		}
	}
	return dist[sink] != INF;

void augment() {
	int flow = bottleneck[sink];
	int cur = sink;
	while (cur != source) {
		int e = prev_edge[cur];
		capacity[e] -= flow;
		capacity[e ^ 1] += flow;
		cur = to[e ^ 1];
	}
	total_cost += flow * dist[sink];

	sink = (n + k - 1) * n + 1;
	for (int i = 1, x; i <= k; i++) {
		scanf("%d", &x);
		insert_edge(source, x, 1, 0);
	}
	for (int i = 1, u, v; i <= m; i++) {
		scanf("%d%d", &u, &v);
		for (int layer = 1; layer <= n + k; layer++) {
			for (int hop = 1; hop <= k; hop++) {
				int weight = d * hop * 2 - d + c;

		insert_edge(1 + (layer - 1) * n, 1 + layer * n, INF, 0);
